claim.text: RMSNorm divides each coordinate by the root mean square of the vector, so a larger epsilon stops that division from shri

spec.explain: Toy RMSNorm sketch for arXiv 1910.07467: the curve is illustrative, not exact. Watch the gain number: near 1 means big values survive, much smaller means epsilon shrinks them.
